full_details: Master Thwaite said he would be brief, and was not. He reached fourteenthly. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not turn. The sand-glass went round twice. At dinner the loaf was a finger short of the notch, the board was threepence, and firing was named at sixpence and not taken. The sentence to Anne stayed on the desk. Nothing went to the Bell. At the Burbages' there was mutton. Derby marries Burghley's granddaughter at Greenwich today, the Queen there, the match put off a week, Tilney's office sewing for it. George Bryan gave the order of such a night: masque, banquet, the hall cleared at midnight. Derby has his own men. You said a wedding wants a play as a feast wants a fool. James said a wedding wants paying for. Kemp called it an excellent occasion for paying players who have already been paid. Nothing was written down.
one_sentence: You sat under a sermon that reached fourteenthly, ate a short loaf, and supped at Holywell.
title: Sat the sermon and supped at Holywell
